title: ECAA F (Failure) sub-graph
description: Hand-authored against the SPEC node/edge object model (v0.2.md §5.7), NOT the internal impl types. Validates the spec-shaped projection emitted by crates/core/src/emitter/ecaa_projection.rs::project_subgraph('F', …). The legacy file name (assumptions.jsonl) is retained for WRROC compatibility; v0.2-conformant readers treat it as the F sub-graph. Each array element is a typed node or a typed edge; closed `type`/`predicate` enums are pinned to ecaa_workflow_types::consts (asserted by schemars_generation.rs).
